question: Across the available daily historical HS300 membership sample, how often does each frozen R266 macro gate pass, how often do gates overlap, and how many otherwise feature-eligible member rows are removed by each gate?
hypothesis: One or more macro gates may remove a large share of feature-eligible rows or trading dates; this is a gate-activity diagnostic only and cannot establish that removed rows would have earned positive returns.

window.basis: full available intersection of frozen r78 daily membership snapshots and local alt_hs300 dates, fixed before examining gate outcomes

population.membership_source: data/research/r78_daily_membership/daily_snapshots.parquet; exact query_date membership, not current members
population.pre_gate_row_cohort: historical member-date rows with enriched ma60 non-null, holder_top10_free_float_share non-null, and all three macro inputs non-null
population.unit_of_macro_gate_statistics: unique trading dates (macro series are market-wide values replicated across symbols)
population.unit_of_row_mask_statistics: eligible historical member-date rows in the frozen pre-gate cohort

metrics_locked_before_execution: For each macro input: non-null dates, pass dates, fail dates, pass rate, and longest consecutive failed-date run.
For all eight pass/fail combinations: unique date counts.
For each gate: pre-gate eligible member-date rows passing the other two gates but blocked by this gate, and its fraction of the other-two-pass cohort.
Full three-gate eligible rows and counterfactual eligible rows after removing exactly one gate; report row counts and incremental rows released.
Report missing macro values, missing holder values, missing ma60 values, and membership/data date coverage separately; do not treat missing values as passes.
execution_and_decision_rules: Before calculating any gate statistics, validate this preregistration hash and every frozen input/source hash. Abort on mismatch.
Use the system historical membership snapshots and the current local enriched and alt_hs300 data only; apply exact R266 thresholds without adjustment.
Do not load or inspect equity-return series, trade logs, equity curves, candidate performance, backtest responses, or paper-trading data.
Do not call a backtest or screener execution route, fetch providers, modify market/ext-data caches, or change strategies, settings, polling, paper accounts, or orders.

This round is complete as a mechanism diagnosis only if source integrity passes, panel registration is read back, and the row/date accounting identities reconcile exactly. It can never pass an alpha decision rule.
Keep the strategy research-only and production pause_production regardless of gate activity.
